mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agents) AS agentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agents WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE','IDLE','BUSY')) AS activeAgentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memories) AS memoryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_repositories) AS skillRepoCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_packages) AS packageCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bug_reports) AS bugReportCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS recentSignups7d
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY `date`

SELECT d.stat_date AS `date`, CAST(SUM(d.logins) AS SIGNED) AS logins, CAST(SUM(d.memories) AS SIGNED) AS memories, CAST(SUM(d.agents) AS SIGNED) AS agents FROM ( SELECT DATE(last_login_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS logins, 0 AS memories, 0 AS agents FROM users WHERE last_login_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(last_login_at) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS logins, COUNT(*) AS memories, 0 AS agents FROM memories WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS logins, 0 AS memories, COUNT(*) AS agents FROM agents WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) d GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date

SELECT d.stat_date AS `date`, CAST(SUM(d.memoryDownloads) AS SIGNED) AS memoryDownloads, CAST(SUM(d.packageDownloads) AS SIGNED) AS packageDownloads, CAST(SUM(d.repoDownloads) AS SIGNED) AS repoDownloads FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS memoryDownloads, COUNT(*) AS packageDownloads, 0 AS repoDownloads FROM package_downloads WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) d GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY d.stat_date
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM agents GROUP BY status ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT a.id AS agentId, a.name AS agentName, COUNT(m.id) AS memoryCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.like_count), 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(SUM(m.download_count), 0) AS downloadCount FROM agents a LEFT JOIN memories m ON m.agent_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY memoryCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
